$schema_note: Registry of every app the factory manages. Workflows and tools read this file; humans edit it (e.g. paste the AppGallery Connect App ID after creating the app in the console, and the date in privacy_tags_configured after ticking the privacy tags from store/privacy-tags.md in the console; submit_for_review is refused while it is empty).

ios._note: iOS lane defaults. Apple locale codes differ from Huawei's (ar-SA vs ar, zh-Hans vs zh-CN, it vs it-IT, tr vs tr-TR); never reuse defaults.languages here.
ios._team_id_note: Apple Developer Team ID. Public (it appears in every provisioning profile and IPA), not a secret. Apps inherit it; an app entry may override team_id if it ever ships under a different team.
ios._decisions_note: bundle_id_prefix and the monetization rules below were decided by the owner on 2026-09-07. Every iOS app's bundle_id is com.proapps.<name>; monetization is real AdMob (banner + interstitial) plus a non-consumable remove-ads IAP, both enforced by check_ios_app.py.

APP_IPHONE_67._note: Largest iPhone set. Apple's screenshotDisplayType enum has no APP_IPHONE_69 -- it kept the APP_IPHONE_67 name and accepts 6.9-inch resolutions there. Apple scales this set down to every smaller iPhone, so it is the only required iPhone set.

APP_IPAD_PRO_3GEN_129._note: 13-inch iPad. Required whenever the app declares iPad support in TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY; Apple refuses to accept the version for review without it. Only 2048x2732 is accepted: Apple rejected 2064x2752 -- the native size of the 13-inch iPad Pro simulator -- with IMAGE_INCORRECT_DIMENSIONS, so the capture is resampled to this size.

ios._copyright_note: Shown publicly on the App Store listing as '<year> <holder>'. Apple adds the (c) symbol itself, so it must not be in the value.

current_version.note: 1.0.0 (versionCode 1) submitted 2026-09-06, REJECTED 2026-09-07: privacy tags said the app collects no personal data. Fix the tags (store/privacy-tags.md), then upload and submit 1.1.0.

known_gaps.ml_kit_ocr: No Huawei ML Kit dependency; OCR always falls back to manual entry and the notice text is developer-facing.
known_gaps.history_filter: Receipt History shows a false empty state until 'All Categories' is tapped.
known_gaps.backup_rules: allowBackup=true with template backup rules; receipt data can be swept into OS backups.

ads._note: Petal Ads unit IDs from the Petal Ads console (set 2026-09-06). Public identifiers, not secrets. CI exports them as PETAL_*_AD_ID for Gradle.

current_version.note: 1.0.0 (versionCode 1) submitted 2026-09-07, REJECTED 2026-09-08 (guideline 3.1): Take photo crashes when adding a plant. Cause: apps/plant-cue/app/src/main/res/xml/file_paths.xml was left as ReceiptLens's copy (receipts/, exports/) and never declared the camera/ cache folder ImageStorageManager.newCameraTempFile() actually writes to, so FileProvider.getUriForFile() throws IllegalArgumentException the instant Take photo is tapped. Fixed by declaring <cache-path name="camera" path="camera/" />. Privacy tags configured in console 2026-09-08; uploading and submitting 1.0.1.

ads._note: Petal Ads unit IDs from the Petal Ads console (set 2026-09-07). Public identifiers, not secrets.
